blind.description: An ornate baroque- or Victorian-style two-seater settee/loveseat. It features a carved polished wood frame with curved scrollwork, cabriole-style legs (six legs total, three in front and three in back), upholstered red velvet seat and backrest cushions, and gold/yellow padded cylindrical armrests. All surfaces are continuous, solid, and fully modeled with no floating shards, holes, or untextured patches.
blind.from_above: From directly above, it appears as a rectangular seat with a curved decorative backrest frame, showing the deep red seat cushion, two yellow armrest bolsters at each end, and the carved wooden crest rail along the back.
blind.height_vs_figure: The settee is approximately half the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure (around 3 feet tall at the back crest) and roughly as wide as the figure is tall (around 4.5 to 5 feet wide).
